ns0:svg.ns0:desc: Inside concentration equals 300 femtomoles of impermeant solute particles divided by volume in picoliters. Horizontal external concentrations 150, 300, 450 millimolar intersect at 2, 1, and two-thirds picoliters. All hydrostatic pressure differences are set to zero in this ideal teaching model.
ns0:svg.ns0:title: Concentration and equilibrium volume
